text: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund is the largest shareholder (19.5%) of Aston Martin Lagonda, the manufacturer behind the Aston Martin THOR Team Hypercar programme; Aston Martin denied FT reports (14 Nov 2025) that PIF would raise its stake and take the company private.
short: PIF is Aston Martin Lagonda's largest shareholder (19.5%); takeover-denied

source.name: CarExpert - Aston Martin denies change of ownership plans after massive losses
